games.description: A multiplayer typing-survival test with NFEN, Diction and StuStutters. The crew enter public rounds, fight the reversed and unusual typing rules, recover from matchmaking trouble, and watch the surviving typist win before moving on.
games.title: Final Sentence

games.description: Two co-op sessions forming one persistent lake run: the first night goes from an immediate crash through a Day 11 save, then the crew returns a week later to continue the same run with new fishing upgrades, swamp and Stargate routes, giant catches, and deeper progression.
games.title: GONE Fishing

games.description: Sark and Diction enter the mansion, test throwable items and hiding spots, and repeatedly die to its creature. They stop after confusing health, traps and hideout tools prevent an escape.
games.title: One, Two, Death

games.description: Sark, Diction and Stu explore the theater hub and try its zombie combat, with NFEN joining later. The group tests weapons, healing darts and a castle route before abandoning the buggy session.
games.title: Outbreak: Shades of Horror

games.description: Sark uses a camera on rails to identify and banish changes in the haunted apartment. A later visit tests the changed apartment and darker anomalies before another reset ends the session.
games.title: Paragnosia

games.description: Sark learns the museum’s exhibits across six visits, finishes the normal campaign and then pursues its remaining nightmare anomalies. The last session reaches all 130 anomalies and repeats the normal ending, but leaves the hidden ending unconfirmed.
games.title: Paragnosia: Museum

games.description: Sark and friends attempt the group tutorial for a haunted railway ghost-catching game. They learn vessel charging, particle weapons, train repairs and enemy attacks before leaving the tutorial.
games.title: Rhyolite

games.description: Sark's Yayos archive follows four co-op survival sessions: two nights learning the elderly life-management gauntlet with APL, a Diction return that reaches one day and fifteen hours, and a Stu run after Sark has climbed to 55th on the global leaderboard.
games.title: Yayos
